_comment: Layer 1. The leadership queue and the leadership backlog. Every item here is a P1 by definition. This file is the data for Layer 1 and is edited by pull request, same as every other config file, so the queue has a git history. `clickupOptionId` ties an item to its Leadership Priority dropdown option in ClickUp; leave null until the option exists and the sync check will flag it.

queue.title: EXAMPLE. Replace this. Subscription upsell test on PDP
queue.notes: state is one of: active, shipped, backlog. owner is a clickup user id from people.json, or null when unassigned. shippedAt and lastMiniReadoutAt are ISO dates and drive the mini readout tolerance check.
